entries.title: Job 39:1
segments: Do you know the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? Can you observe the calving of deer?

entries.title: Job 39:2
segments: Can you number the months [that] they fulfill? Or do you know the time for their bearing,

entries.title: Job 39:3
segments: [when] they bow down [and] bring forth; they send out their pangs.

entries.title: Job 39:4
segments: Their young ones are strong, they multiply with grain; they go forth and do not return to them again.

entries.title: Job 39:5
segments: Who has sent out the wild ass free? Or who has loosed the bands of the wild ass,

entries.title: Job 39:6
segments: to whom I have assigned the wilderness [for] its home, and the salt land [for] its dwellings?

entries.title: Job 39:7
segments: He scorns the turmoil of the city; he does not hear the driver's shouts.

entries.title: Job 39:8
segments: He seeks out mountains [for] his pasture, and he searches after every green thing.

entries.title: Job 39:9
segments: Will the wild ox be willing to serve you, or spend the night by your feed-trough?

entries.title: Job 39:10
segments: Can you tie the wild ox [in] the furrow [with] his rope? Or will he harrow the valleys for you?

entries.title: Job 39:11
segments: Will you trust him because his strength [is] great? Or will you leave your labor to him?

entries.title: Job 39:12
segments: Will you trust him, that he will return your seed and gather [it to] your grain-floor?

entries.title: Job 39:13
segments: The wing of the ostrich beats joyously; though not [like] the stork's pinions [for] flight.

entries.title: Job 39:14
segments: For she leaves her eggs to the earth, and lets them warm in the dust,

entries.title: Job 39:15
segments: and forgets that a foot may crush them, or that the beast of the field may break them.

entries.title: Job 39:16
segments: She treats her young roughly, as if not hers; for her labor [is] vanity without fear;

entries.title: Job 39:17
segments: because God has caused her to forget wisdom, and He has not given her a share in understanding.

entries.title: Job 39:18
segments: At the time she lifts herself up on high, she scorns the horse and its rider.

entries.title: Job 39:19
segments: Have you given the horse strength? Have you clothed his neck [with] a mane?

entries.title: Job 39:20
segments: Can you make him leap like a locust? The glory of his snorting [is] terrifying.

entries.title: Job 39:21
segments: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in [his] strength; he goes on to meet the weapons.

entries.title: Job 39:22
segments: He mocks at fear, and is not terrified; and he does not turn back from the sword.

entries.title: Job 39:23
segments: The quiver rattles against him, the glittering spear and the shield.

entries.title: Job 39:24
segments: He swallows the ground with quivering and rage; and he does not stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

entries.title: Job 39:25
segments: When the trumpet [sounds], he says, Aha! And he smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

entries.title: Job 39:26
segments: Does the hawk soar by your understanding? Will he spread his wings toward the south?

entries.title: Job 39:27
segments: Does the eagle mount up at your command and make his nest on high?

entries.title: Job 39:28
segments: He lives and stays [on the] rock, on the crag of the rock and [the] strong place.

entries.title: Job 39:29
segments: From there he seeks food, and his eyes see afar off.

entries.title: Job 39:30
segments: And his young brood also sucks up blood; and where the dead [are], there he [is].
